title: RMO — Riemann Map Operator
description: RMO version 1.0.0-rc4 preserves the R139 scientific state and the established QuickLook interface for local ideal-MHD interpretation of declared solar constraints. The hosted application is available at https://rmo-solar.org/. This software archive contains runtime source, reviewed presentation assets, licenses, citation metadata and scoped validation records. Previous rc3 targeted hosted checks covered A63 local diagnosis and exports, B01 contact calculations and a normal/incognito comparison. Remaining interactive coverage is documented in docs/RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Scientific statements remain conditional on documented inputs, models and search limits; full MHD branch coverage, uniqueness, stability and observational identification are not established by these smoke tests. The scientific data and reproduction companion R139 is a separate archive. Original RMO code is Apache-2.0; third-party material retains its specified terms and source acknowledgements. Version rc4 restores the original SUVI preview and comparison video with NOAA SWPC attribution and Seaton and Darnel (2018) as the scientific reference. No numerical scientific results are changed.
